# Local Macroquad vendor scope

This isolated Pong adapter candidate vendors the complete published macroquad 0.4.16 registry source, including README, licenses, examples and tests. Cargo.toml.orig preserves the published manifest. The active Cargo.toml removes the quad-rand dependency and four example targets (asteroids, life, rustaceanmark and snake) that rely on the removed random API; their source files remain as upstream evidence. The library removes the corresponding rand re-exports. This intentionally narrows the vendored API for Pong and is not a general-purpose drop-in Macroquad release.

The workspace excludes the vendor directory as a workspace member while retaining the crates.io path override. All 36 remaining declared readme/lib/example/test paths exist. The Pong adapter passed 10 offline locked tests. A standalone all-targets, no-run compilation could not resolve the uncached quad-snd dependency offline; it has not passed and should be run in an appropriately provisioned environment before treating all retained example/test targets as verified. No graphical replay or physical-input verification was performed. The earlier compact review bundle was a source-diff subset, not the complete durable vendor tree; do not integrate that subset as the vendor directory.

Upstream macroquad 0.4.16 published archive SHA-256: 1cbd54d99d4d3ac59deed7ee4927bbbf4eb33a55635530af3be9395a55746090. Existing MIT and Apache notices and original manifest are preserved. Registry cache marker .cargo-ok is omitted. No upstream example source is deleted; excluded random-API examples are not supported by this scoped vendored API.
